source.name: SportsLogos.Net News – 'MLS Expansion Franchise St. Louis City SC Launches Inaugural Home Kits'
source.quote: All 29 MLS teams will have Apple TV+ patches on their kits this season after the sides reached a 10-year broadcasting rights deal that starts with the 2023 season.

note: League-wide sleeve patch since 2023, when the Apple–MLS broadcasting deal began; shown as a league deal (clubId null) because Apple pays MLS, not the club.
